+import jinja2
+import asyncio
+
+async def run():
+    jinja_env = jinja2.Environment(enable_async=True)
+    jinja_env.filters.update({'add_two': lambda x, y: [i+y for i in x]})
+    tmpl = jinja_env.from_string('{% for item in (a.b|add_two(5))[:1] %}{{ item }}{% endfor %}')
+    try:
+        print(await tmpl.render_async(a=dict(b=[1,2,3])))
+    except Exception as e:
+        import traceback
+        traceback.print_exc()
+
+asyncio.run(run())
